sanskrit: saṃkrāmo 'tra na bhāvanā na ca kathāyuktir na carcā na ca dhyānaṃ vā na ca dhāraṇā na ca japābhyāsaprayāso na ca | tat kiṃ nāma suniścitaṃ vada paraṃ satyaṃ ca tac chrūyatām: na tyāgī na parigrahī — bhaja sukhaṃ sarvam yathāvasthitaḥ
l1:
## anu-p01 (1)
transition / here / not / contemplation / nor / connection-of-speech / nor / discussion / nor / visualization / or / nor / steadying / nor / japa-practice-effort / That / what / name / well-decided / speak / supreme / truth / and / that / hear / not / renouncer / not / possessor / enjoy / happiness / all / as-staying // anu-p01
l2: Transition here is no method at all — not contemplation, not speech-connection, not discussion, not visualization, not steadying, not japa-practice-effort. So what is well-decided? Speak the supreme truth, and hear it: not renouncer, not possessor — enjoy happiness, wholly, as staying.

sanskrit: saṃsāro 'sti na tattvatas tanubhṛtāṃ bandhasya vārtaiva kā bandho yasya na jātu tasya vitathā muktasya muktikriyā | mithyāmohakṛd eṣa rajjubhujagacchāyāpiśācabhramo mā kiṃcit tyaja mā gṛhāṇa vihara svastho yathāvasthitaḥ

pūjapūjakapūjyabhedasaraṇiḥ keyaṃ kathānuttare saṃkrāmaḥ kila kasya kena vidadhe ko vā praveśakramaḥ | māyeyam na cidadvayāt paratayā bhinnāpy aho vartate sarvaṃ svānubhavasvabhāvavimalaṃ cintāṃ vṛthā mā kṛthāḥ

ānando 'tra na vittamadhyamadavan naivāṅganāsaṅgavat dīpārkendukṛtaprabhāprakaravan naiva prakāśodayaḥ | harṣaḥ saṃbhṛtabhedamuktisukhabhūr bhārāvatāropamaḥ sarvādvaitapadasya vismṛtanidheḥ prāptiḥ prakāśodayaḥ

rāgadveṣasukhāsukhodayalayāhaṅkāradainyādayo ye bhāvāḥ pravibhānti viśvavapuṣo bhinnasvabhāvā na te | vyaktiṃ paśyasi yasya yasya sahasā tattattadekātmatāsaṃvidrūpam avekṣya kiṃ na ramase tadbhāvanānirbharaḥ
l1:
## anu-p05 (5)
Passion / aversion / pleasure / displeasure / rise / dissolution / I-ness / misery / and-the-rest / those / things / shining-forth / universe-bodied / different-natured / not / Manifestation / you-see / of-whom / suddenly / that-that / one-self-natured / consciousness-form / having-regarded / why / do-you-delight / with-that / contemplation-full // anu-p05
l2: Passion, aversion, pleasure, displeasure, rise and fall, I-ness, misery and the rest — things shining forth, universe-bodied, are not different-natured. Whosever manifestation you suddenly see — having regarded it as one-self-natured consciousness-form — why do you not delight, full of contemplation?

sanskrit: pūrvābhāvabhavakriyā hi sahasā bhāvāḥ sadā 'smin bhave madhyākāravikārasaṃkaravatāṃ teṣāṃ kutaḥ satyatā | niḥsatye capale prapañcanicaye svapnabhrame peśale śaṅkātaṅkakalaṅkayuktikalanātītaḥ prabuddho bhava
l1:
## anu-p06 (6)
Former / non-being / being / action / indeed / suddenly / things / always / in-this / existence / middle-formed / transformation / confusion / of-them / whence / truth / In-non-truth / unsteady / manifold / dream-delusion / clever / from-doubt- fear-stain-reasoning-transcended / awakened / become // anu-p06
l2: Former non-being, being, action — things always, suddenly, in this existence: middle-formed, transformation-confused — whence their truth? In the non-true, unsteady, manifold, clever dream-delusion — transcending doubt, fear, stain, and reasoning's contriving: awakened, become.

sanskrit: bhāvānāṃ na samudbhavo 'sti sahajas tvadbhāvitā bhānty amī niḥsatyā api satyatām anubhavabhrāntyā bhajanti kṣaṇam | tvatsaṅkalpaja eṣa viśvamahimā nāsty asya janmānyataḥ tasmāt tvaṃ vibhavena bhāsi bhuvaneṣv ekopy anekātmakaḥ
l1:
## anu-p07 (7)
Of-things / no / arising / natural / by-your-contemplation / they-shine / non-true / truth / by-experience-delusion / partake / for-a-moment / This / universe-glory / from-your-will-born / not / its / birth / from-elsewhere / Hence / you / by-splendor / shine / in-worlds / one / many-selfed // anu-p07
l2: Of things there is no arising; naturally, by your contemplation they shine; even the non-true partakes of truth for a moment, through experience's delusion. This universe-glory is will-born from you, birth from elsewhere it has none; hence by splendor you shine in worlds — one, yet many-selfed.

sanskrit: yat satyaṃ yad asatyam alpabahulaṃ nityaṃ na nityaṃ ca yat yan māyāmalinaṃ yad ātmavimalaṃ ciddarpaṇe rājate | tat sarvaṃ svavimarśasaṃvidudayād rūpaprakāśātmakaṃ jñātvā svānubhavādhirūḍhamahimā viśveśvaratvaṃ bhaja
l1:
## anu-p08 (8)
What / true / what / untrue / little-much / eternal / not / eternal / what / Māyā-stained / what / self-pure / in- consciousness-mirror / shines / That / all / from-own-grasping-consciousness-rise / form-light-natured / having-known / own-experience-risen / glory / Lordhood / worship // anu-p08
l2: What true, what untrue, little-much, eternal, not eternal, what Māyā-stained, what self-pure — in the consciousness-mirror shines. That all, from own-grasping-consciousness-rise, form-light-natured, having known — own-experience-risen glory: Lordhood — worship.
